title: Security work at Nutanix
story: Jr. Full Stack Developer (contract), client Nutanix. Amiseq, January 2026 to present, and Mastech Digital, March 2025 to January 2026.
bullets: Assisted application development teams during security incident windows by analyzing codebase exposure, validating software fixes, and tracking emergency patch status for zero-day vulnerabilities.
Designed and implemented an automated data analytics pipeline to track vulnerability trends over time, providing leadership with enhanced visibility into system patching metrics across product lines.
Utilized app-scanning technologies including Wiz, Black Duck, Tenable, and Harbor to support SAST, SCA, and CSPM assessments for core engineering products.
Authored technical customer-facing security advisories, remediation guides, and internal knowledge base articles covering software vulnerabilities and secure coding practices.
